notes: Anime themes: nine whole looks inspired by Bleach, Tokyo Ghoul, Demon Slayer, Jujutsu Kaisen, Naruto, Attack on Titan, One Piece, Death Note and Persona 5 (fan-made, not official)
The whole browser takes the theme's colors and accent, with its own band across the top of the window
A live wallpaper behind the new tab page and a card with the time and date in the theme's style
Its own sound if you want it: rain, wind, waves or a storm. No anime theme brings back your look
